name: Floodslain Orc — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Floodslain Orc from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Orc, Floodslain", "Floodslain Creature (CR +1)" but are not part of the Floodslain Orc entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Orc, Floodslain

ECOLOGY

Environment any plains or ruins
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental (masterwork hide armor, masterwork spear)

When snowmelt floods it causes flash floods. Those who drown in the turbulent waters often rise as floodslain and spread the misery and death that created them.
